Alex G: FYI I just did an HF->Redwood conversion of 'galactica-spm-patched' and the model is spitting out stray placeholder tokens mid-sentence after quantization. Looks like something shifted in the token id mapping. Anyone seen noncanonical merge ordering from an spm merges/vocab rewrite? :eyes:
Maria T: Did you use the HF SentencePiece wrapper or the raw spm model + our conv script? Check config.json special_tokens_map too — chat templates sometimes expect different pad/eos names and we remap badly.
Sam L: Seen this when our conv script reorders vocab (we sorted entries by token string accidentally). That changes ids. We must preserve original spm ids. Try running the id-checker: 
```bash
python -c "from tokenizers import Tokenizer; t=Tokenizer.from_file('converted.json'); print(t.get_vocab_size())"
```
InfraBot: conv-run #134: converted galactica-spm-patched -> bpe, quant=4bit, sanity-sample: "The quick <extra_id_0> brown" (perplexity 25.7) :warning:
Kevin P: Common culprits: 1) merges/vocab order rewritten, 2) special token name mismatch (pad vs <pad>), 3) config.json 'add_prefix_space' differences. Also watch for unicode normalization (NFKC) differences between HF tokenizer and our loader.
Jen R: Quick checklist I use on bring-up: 1) export spm vocab with original ids (spm_export.py) 2) run tokens sanity: 
```python
from transformers import AutoTokenizer
 tok = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('converted')
 for t in ['<unk>', '<pad>', '<s>', '</s>', '<extra_id_0>']:
     print(t, tok.convert_tokens_to_ids(t))
```
Alex G: Thanks — found the bug. Our conv step sorted merge entries in two places which bumped suffix-piece ids. Re-ran preserving original spm order + fixed special_tokens_map and the stray placeholders are gone. Kicking off a full eval now. :partyparrot:
Maria T: Nice. When you have eval numbers, add a regression check: 1k prompts, compare Rouge/Embedding sim, fail if >2% quality drop. I'll add to the onboarding checklist. :+1:
Sam L: For the quantization-related token flakiness, also try disabling k-v cache reordering optimizations during the first pass; some kernels assume contiguous id ranges that break when ids were remapped.
InfraBot: eval-run #789 queued by Alex G. ETA ~2h.
Kevin P: If anything else pops up, drop the raw tokenizer files (spm.model, vocab.txt, merges.txt) and we can diff original vs converted ids. Less magic, more diffs. :facepalm:
Jen R: Also log the config.json fields we care about: tokenizer_class, special_tokens_map, add_prefix_space, eos_token_id, pad_token_id. Saves time later.
